Package com.github.crittscott.somebuckets.client

Class ClientPlatform

java.lang.Object
com.github.crittscott.somebuckets.client.ClientPlatform
@Environment(CLIENT) public final class ClientPlatform extends Object
The client's loader seam: the loader's fluid rendering facts and spawn-egg lookup, plus the config directory and loader name the diagnostic reports need. The Big and Huge Bucket bar color, the Mob Bucket tint, and the /sb diagnostic samples are derived here from those facts; item models stay loader-owned.

  • Method Details

    • install

      public static void install(ClientPlatform.FluidFactsSource factsSource, Function<net.minecraft.world.entity.EntityType<?>,net.minecraft.world.item.SpawnEggItem> eggLookup, Path loaderConfigDir, String loader)
      Installs the loader's client seam and the bar-color resolver it backs. Called once during client bootstrap.
      Parameters:
      factsSource - the loader's fluid rendering facts
      eggLookup - the loader's spawn egg for an entity type, or null for none
      loaderConfigDir - the loader config directory; reports go under <dir>/somebuckets/
      loader - short loader name for report headers ("Forge", "Fabric")

    • reloadResources

      public static void reloadResources()
      Drops every client color and geometry cache after a resource reload, then averages every source fluid's still texture so drawing a bucket bar never reads a file. Each loader calls this from its client resource reload listener. Stack-dependent variant textures are averaged on first use.
